ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade AI health platform featuring rPPG touchless heart rate sensing and offline-first multilingual triage for rural health camps.
ideas.title: MediTriage-Edge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of mediscan-ai by focusing on hardware-agnostic clinical utility and a working live demo that judges can immediately test via webcam.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform to detect unauthorized industrial land expansion and environmental zoning violations.
ideas.title: AeroSat-LandCompliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the GeoNex-ATLAS pattern, providing high-impact visual proof of geospatial anomaly detection that immediately appeals to government and climate judges.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first macOS desktop agent that monitors incoming audio streams and protects elderly users from vishing and email phishing scams in real time.
ideas.title: SeniorShield-VoiceAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning pattern of gosim-zai-hack-winner by targeting consumer safety through an end-to-end working voice pipeline under extreme time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and web dashboard platform that ingests local water sensor feeds to predict harmful algal bloom risks 3 to 5 days in advance.
ideas.title: AquaSense-IoT-Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of iForeSea-AquaSense-IoT-Hackathon by combining predictive time-series machine learning with an actionable municipal dashboard.

ideas.pitch: An interactive medical student training platform where users interview an AI patient scored on a strict rubric alongside computer-vision posture tracking.
ideas.title: OSCE-Clinical-Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the Cornell AI Hackathon grand prize formula by delivering a deeply functional vertical domain tool rather than a generic chatbot.
